declared.characterization_status: Complete: 112 pristine and 112 corrected source cases; 90 identical cases and 22 explicitly accepted changed cases. Focused source captures for 14 additional authorization, validation-precedence, and conflict branches passed. Full Go parity and release proof remain pending.

differential_replay.environment: Pinned Django plus the accepted source correction patch, pinned baseline Go/proxy and staged candidate Go/proxy use two separately seeded PostgreSQL clones, Redis10/11 and dedicated RabbitMQ vhosts. DEBUG=False is asserted. Missing cycle detail samples and invalid empty writes keep the matrix repeatable; successful writes and durable effects are covered by fixture replay.

source_branches.observable: Legacy app routes use session authentication and allow_permission: active project ADMIN/MEMBER roles, or an active workspace ADMIN with any active project membership. App DELETE additionally requires active workspace membership before its created_by grant; that creator grant can apply without an active project membership. API v1 uses API-key authentication and ProjectEntityPermission; the app workspace-admin fallback does not apply. Missing and cross-scope behavior is captured per operation.
Draft and uncompleted cycles reject archive with 400. Completed cycles archive; legacy removes favorites and returns archived_at JSON 200, while v1 returns empty 204. Unarchive returns empty 204.
